headline: Pilgrim’s Pride Opens $40 Million Plant in Mexico
summary: Pilgrim’s Pride has opened a new $40 million plant in Gómez Palacio, Durango, as part of a broader $1.3 billion investment plan for Mexico through 2030.
why: Pilgrim's Pride is a major global poultry producer; its capital expenditure in Mexico reflects the company's strategy to expand production capacity in the North American market.

impacts.name: Pilgrim's Pride
impacts.why: Long-term capital investment is intended to drive future growth.
